experiment.hypothesis: Variant B leads with reassurance about the soft search rather than with speed. We expect credit-anxious users to drop off less on the credit-history step when the absence of a hard check is stated up front rather than at the end.
experiment.primaryMetric: cta_click_rate — unique sessions with cta_clicked divided by unique sessions with session_started
